messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 1):
"""
Master Circular on Health Insurance Business Version:1 29052024 Ref: IRDAI/HLT/CIR/PRO/84/5/ 2024 Date: 29.05.2024 To All General Insurers, Health Insurers and Life Insurers Sub: Master Circular on IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024- Health Insurance A. This Master Circular is issued under the section 14(2)(e) of the IRDAI Act 1999and section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938 read with Regulation 7 of schedule-III of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024. B. The Master Circular shall be reviewed every year unless review or repeal is warranted earlier. C. The Returns referred under this circular shall be submitted as per the provisions herein and the Master Circular on submission of returns. D.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
